items.title: Joe Robichaux Interview, 1959-03-19
items.q: he had Sweetie Matthews working with him, Octavia Summers

ctx.x: And I used to be up there every day and be at the rehearsals and he had Sweetie Matthews working with him, Octavia Summers, and they had Bichet and that was actually the first saxophone that Bichet ever played was Clarence Williams' saxophone.
Was it an alto or a C melody?
